fact: GAFI says it launched its Company e-Incorporation Service in September 2023, with sole proprietorships, partnerships and LLCs now incorporated exclusively online.

The Internal Trade Development Authority says six new services were added to the Digital Egypt platform, bringing Commercial Registry services available online to 20, including a digital trade name reservation service launched with GAFI.
Egypt's Ministry of Investment and Foreign Trade says that from 3 August 2025 applications to incorporate all limited liability companies are accepted only on the GAFI electronic portal.
